title: Bahrain International Airport wins three awards at the 2026 Skytrax World Airport Awards
summary: As passenger traffic returned to normal levels

Ahmed Mohamed Janahi, BAC Chief Executive Officer . Image Courtesy: Bahrain Airport Company (BAC)

As passenger traffic returned to normal levels

Press Release

Muharraq, Kingdom of Bahrain: Bahrain Airport Company (BAC), the operator and managing body of Bahrain International Airport (BIA), announced that the airport secured three awards at the 2026 Skytrax World Airport Awards, as passenger traffic returned to normal levels, while continuing to maintain high standards of service quality and operational efficiency.

BIA was named World’s Best Airport – 5–10 Million Passengers for the second consecutive year, Best Airport Staff in the Middle East for the fourth time, following previous wins in 2013, 2023 and 2024, and Cleanest Airport in the Middle East for the second consecutive year.

In the broader Skytrax results, BIA ranked 20th among the World’s Top 100 Airports, placing it among the three highest-ranked airports in the Middle East. It also ranked fourth among the world’s cleanest airports handling up to 30 million passengers annually.

Khalid Hussain Taqi, Gulf Air Group Chairman, commented: “Bahrain International Airport’s performance across the Skytrax awards and rankings reinforces our strategy to position the airport as a high-performing, passenger-focused gateway and a key enabler of the Kingdom’s connectivity with the world.”

He added: “By aligning service excellence, operational resilience and investment in people, we are strengthening the airport’s competitiveness and supporting the continued advancement of Bahrain’s aviation sector.”

Ahmed Mohamed Janahi, BAC Chief Executive Officer, highlighted the efforts of the airport’s teams, in cooperation with strategic partners, during a period of changing passenger demand, noting that their high level of professionalism, teamwork and unwavering commitment to excellence, even under the most demanding circumstances, enabled the airport to maintain smooth operations and consistent service standards as passenger traffic returned to normal levels.

He added: “We will continue to invest in our people, enhance our services and facilities, and refine our processes to meet passenger needs and build on the airport’s achievements.”

The Skytrax World Airport Awards are based on an annual global customer satisfaction survey evaluating the passenger experience across key airport services and facilities, including check-in, arrivals, transfers, security, immigration, shopping, food and beverage, and departure procedures at the gates.

About Bahrain Airport Company (BAC)

Bahrain Airport Company (BAC) has been responsible for the management and operation of Bahrain International Airport (BIA) since 2010. It ensures the highest standards of safety, efficiency, and passenger experience at BIA, overseeing the airport’s infrastructure development, managing its facilities, and supervising its operational and commercial services. BAC has continued to strengthen BIA’s position as a preferred destination for airlines and travellers by adopting international best practices and continuously enhancing the travel experience in line with global standards. Through Hala Bahrain, BAC provides premium meet and assist services, operates and manages the Awal Private Terminal for private aviation guests, and manages The Pearl Lounge at BIA. These services reflect the company’s commitment to delivering a seamless and elevated travel experience for all passenger segments. For more information, please visit www.bahrainairport.bh
